description:
THIS IS A FIRM FIXED-PRICE SUPPLY-TYPE PROCUREMENT

NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound, in support of SRF-JRMC, is soliciting an UNRESTRICTED requirement for the procurement of OEM The Entwistle Company, LLC - Sliding Padeye Repair Parts. Please see the attached solicitation document(s) for requirement details.

Prospective offerors are responsible for downloading their own copy of the solicitation from this website, and for frequently monitoring that site for any amendments. The Government is not responsible for any inability of the offeror to access any of the posted solicitation documents.

This solicitation closes 17 MAR 2026 @ 1200 PDT.

All questions regarding this solicitation should be submitted to the Contract Specialist - Walid Aslan (walid.m.aslan.civ@us.navy.mil).
